note: Answers from the API that are worked out from the SERVER's clock, captured once. context.clock in tools/plates.mjs freezes only the browser, so without these the plates stop matching within days of being taken: 48 of 464 failed on 2026-11-05 against a 2026-10-31 baseline with no code change at all. Two causes: the horoscope day comes from c.now (src/horoscope/horoscope.js dayOf -> localDay, and localDay discards a client date more than 2.5 days off the server's), and #ourspace keeps only the last 24 hours (src/chats/ourspace.js WINDOW, m.created > c.now - KEEP_MS). Keyed on pathname; the query is ignored. Regenerating these means deliberately re-baselining the horoscope, home--in and ourspace--in plates. docs/mobile/harness.md.
